items.name: event_loop_pp
items.condition: disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.NULL and not (scheduler.enable_pdmux) and get_parallel().pp_size > 1

items.name: event_loop_overlap_mlx
items.condition: disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.NULL and not (scheduler.enable_pdmux) and not (get_parallel().pp_size > 1) and scheduler.enable_overlap_mlx

items.name: event_loop_overlap
items.condition: disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.NULL and not (scheduler.enable_pdmux) and not (get_parallel().pp_size > 1) and not (scheduler.enable_overlap_mlx) and scheduler.enable_overlap

items.name: event_loop_normal
items.condition: disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.NULL and not (scheduler.enable_pdmux) and not (get_parallel().pp_size > 1) and not (scheduler.enable_overlap_mlx) and not (scheduler.enable_overlap)

items.name: event_loop_pp_disagg_prefill
items.condition: not (disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.NULL) and disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.PREFILL and get_parallel().pp_size > 1

items.name: event_loop_overlap_disagg_prefill
items.condition: not (disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.NULL) and disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.PREFILL and not (get_parallel().pp_size > 1) and scheduler.enable_overlap

items.name: event_loop_normal_disagg_prefill
items.condition: not (disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.NULL) and disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.PREFILL and not (get_parallel().pp_size > 1) and not (scheduler.enable_overlap)

items.name: event_loop_pp_disagg_decode

items.name: event_loop_overlap_disagg_decode

items.name: event_loop_normal_disagg_decode

items.name: need_grammar_sync
items.condition: batch and (not batch.spec_algorithm.is_none()) and batch.grammar_needs_sync() and batch.forward_mode.is_decode() and (len(self.result_queue) > 0)

items.name: BlockStored
items.when: tail.medium == event.medium and tail.lora_id == event.lora_id and (tail.block_size == event.block_size) and (tail.cache_salt == event.cache_salt) and (tail.session_id == event.session_id) and (tail.lora_name == event.lora_name) and tail.block_hashes and (event.parent_block_hash == tail.block_hashes[-1])
